query:
SELECT s.companyName as sponsor, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, m.timeSlot, m.id as meeting_id
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId
WHERE 
  (s.companyName LIKE '%PerchPeek%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Adam','Jonathan'))
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Stepstone%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Adam','Jessica Shaunie','Joanna','Carly'))
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Wilson%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Tush','James','Mark','Anna','Michelle','Alan'))
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Radancy%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Joanna','Salina'))
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Poetry%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Lucy','Sarah'))
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Udder%' AND dp.firstName IN ('Jules','Robyn'))
ORDER BY s.companyName, m.timeSlot;
